claim: Declares vehicle presence, which buys background motion, ambience and passing headlights in one setting. In a night exterior it doubles as a free lighting rig you never have to place.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: a single car in the distance, one passing vehicle
cars on the road, moving traffic, several vehicles
traffic jam, line of cars, bumper to bumper
heavy traffic, many cars, headlight streaks, crowded road

look_at: cars escalate from one to rush gridlock.
